title: Metabolic FCH micelles do not need their gated shell: with no gate and the catalyst 100x slower they metabolize, grow and divide as well as the full world (2 seeds)
summary: In c03's metabolic micelles the gate on the catalyst was switched off (beta=0) and only the catalyst diffusivity lowered uniformly. Dc=0.1: all bodies die by t~490, as with beta=0. Dc=0.03: all founders live to t=800 but none divide. Dc=0.01: 44/44 and 39/41 founder lineages alive, 20 and 21 persistent splits (generation 2-3), catalyst held at 22-26x with every body >= 2x, against 24/26 alive and 25 splits for the full gated world on seed 7. So the shell's job (keeping the self-made catalyst) is done equally by slow diffusion, and the metabolic, dividing cell survives a matched lowered-D twin. Seed 6 produces non-finite fields at frame 1 for the unmodified world.

finding.operator: self-made shell layer gating the catalyst (D e^{-beta q}) in metabolic FCH micelles
finding.control: matched lowered-D twin: gate off, catalyst Dc uniformly 0.1 / 0.03 / 0.01, seeds 5 and 7; full world on seed 7
finding.result: Dc 0.1: all dead by t~490; Dc 0.03: 26/26 alive, 0 splits (2 seeds); Dc 0.01: 44/44 and 39/41 alive, 20/21 persistent splits, gen 2-3, catalyst 22-26x; full world seed 7: 24/26 alive, 25 splits
